details.malta_time: 15:06–18:59 CEST (UTC+2) on Saturday 17 October by the episode duration; next BBC schedule entry begins at 19:00 Malta time.
details.bbc_schedule_basis: The BBC Europe and Middle East schedule renders the programme at 09:06 page-local. Its adjacent 09:00 BBC News bulletin is timestamped 13:01 GMT, indicating a UTC−4 rendered offset; applying that offset gives a 13:06 GMT start, which is 15:06 in Malta (UTC+2). The episode page gives a duration of 3 hours 53 minutes, yielding a calculated end of 18:59 Malta time; the next BBC schedule entry begins at 19:00.
